item.title: WA's SR 20 North Cascades Highway closed for the season
item.description: The State Route 20 North Cascades Highway has officially closed for the winter season, and won't reopen until the spring.The North Cascades Highway closed to traffic at 6 p.m. on Thursday, Dec. 4. The closure points are between the Ross Dam trailhead and Silver Star Mountain gate. item.title: Connor McDavid hat trick buries Seattle Kraken in 4th straight loss, 9-4, to Oilers
item.description: Connor McDavid had his 13th career hat trick to tie Mark Messier for fourth in Oilers history and added an assist in Edmonton's 9-4 romp over the Seattle Kraken on Thursday night.
